capability: Add up small changes before they add up
title: Small changes, one counter.

hook.picture: Close on the line. The whale makes one tiny bend: fine. Another tiny bend. Another. Each one barely visible.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Every change was fine. Together they changed everything.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: head of a docs team at quarter end

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Dozens of tiny bends, each with a small tick beside it, add up to a line that has wandered far from its start. Three more bends, accelerating.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: We check each step. Never the sum.

stakes.body: A quarter of fine edits leaves docs nobody recognises. People who learned the old version get it wrong.

solution_hint: Keep a running total. Stop when full.

metaphor.body: Each small bend of the line adds a sliver to one counter bar. When the bar nears its line, the whale stops and asks.

steps.picture: The counter bar sits by the line, starting empty. Each tiny bend adds a sliver of copper to the bar.
Bends pile up and the bar fills step by step. Each sliver is small, but the bar keeps the sum.
steps.words: Small steps add up in plain sight.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.3). The bar reaches its reserve line. A gate ahead closes and the whale stops editing and turns toward the viewer.
steps.words: Budget nearly gone? Stop and ask.

steps.picture: Ticks under the line, one per step, each carrying its sliver.
steps.words: This wobble has a name: drift.

real_case.claim: The memory graph merge (548 entities) finished with soft drift 0.0 under the wikictl gates. The noether-wiki skill caps each step (default 2.0) and the session (default 10.0).

honest_limit.picture: A dot keeps its place but changes colour: the same shape, a different meaning. The bar does not move and every gate passes.
honest_limit.words: The counter misses what nobody measures.

not_this.body: A budget limits wobble, not wrong ideas.

ending_pattern.body: The ghost of the original line returns beside the edited line. After a quarter of edits the two nearly match, and the bar has room left.
ending_pattern.callback: The long copper gap between old and new line in FELT is a hairline, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Track the total, not just each change.
